create_openai_backend: create an OpenAI backend instance with a model name, chat template, and Azure support flag
create_logit_bias_int: create a logit bias mask for integer token IDs to constrain OpenAI completions to numeric output
run_openai_completion: run an OpenAI chat or completion API call with retry logic and token usage tracking
run_openai_completion_stream: run a streaming OpenAI chat or completion API call yielding incremental content chunks
test_openai_select: test the OpenAI select method that picks the best choice from a list using greedy token matching and logit bias
